item.title: 2026-06-10 Evening News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good morning and welcome to our daily news talk. I am Aria.
(早上好，欢迎收听我们的每日新闻谈话。我是 Aria。)
[Andrew] And I am Andrew. We have a very big day of news for you.
(我是 Andrew。今天我们有很多重大的新闻要带给大家。)
[Aria] We will look at the new Apple phone, the money market, and the hard news from the world.
(我们将关注苹果新款手机、金融市场以及来自世界各地的重大新闻。)
[Andrew] It is a busy time. Let us start with the new Apple phone news.
(现在非常忙碌。让我们从苹果手机的新闻开始吧。)
[Aria] Apple has a new phone coming. It is the iPhone 17. But there is a problem.
(苹果有一款新手机即将推出。那就是 iPhone 17。但有一个问题。)
[Andrew] Yes, the memory limit is the issue. It only has eight gigabytes.
(是的，内存限制是个问题。它只有 8GB。)
[Aria] Because of this, it cannot use some new smart computer programs.
(正因如此，它无法使用一些新的智能计算机程序。)
[Andrew] These programs are part of the new system. It is a shame for the users.
(这些程序是新系统的一部分。这对用户来说很可惜。)
[Aria] The system is called iOS 27. It needs more power to work well.
(这个系统叫 iOS 27。它需要更多的动力才能良好运行。)
[Andrew] Apple is trying to make its smart system better. They call it Siri.
(苹果正试图改进其智能系统。他们称之为 Siri。)
[Aria] But if the phone does not have enough memory, the smart system will be slow.
(但如果手机内存不足，智能系统就会变慢。)
[Andrew] This is a big change in the market. People want the best tools.
(这是市场上的一个重大变化。人们想要最好的工具。)
[Aria] Also, there is a new design change for the computer system. It is called Liquid Glass.
(此外，计算机系统还有一个新的设计变化。它被称为液体玻璃。)
[Andrew] People did not like the old look. Now Apple is making it better.
(人们不喜欢旧的外观。现在苹果正在改进它。)
[Aria] They are changing the way the screen looks. It will be more clear.
(他们正在改变屏幕的外观。它会更清晰。)
[Andrew] This is good news for people who use Apple computers for work.
(这对使用苹果电脑工作的人来说是个好消息。)
[Aria] Let us move to cameras. Insta360 has a new camera.
(让我们转到相机。Insta360 有一款新相机。)
[Andrew] It is called the Luna Ultra. It is very small and strong.
(它叫 Luna Ultra。它非常小巧且强大。)
[Aria] It is made to compete with the DJI camera.
(它是为了与大疆相机竞争而制造的。)
[Andrew] The video quality is very high. It is eight K quality.
(视频质量非常高。是 8K 质量。)
[Aria] That is very clear. Many people who make videos will want this.
(那非常清晰。许多制作视频的人会想要这个。)
[Andrew] It also has a special tool to keep the picture steady.
(它还有一个特殊的工具来保持画面稳定。)
[Aria] That is important for walking and filming at the same time.
(这对边走边拍很重要。)
[Andrew] Now, let us talk about money. The news is not very good.
(现在，让我们谈谈钱。消息不太好。)
[Aria] Inflation is going up in the United States. This is the biggest jump in three years.
(美国的通货膨胀正在上升。这是三年来的最大涨幅。)
[Andrew] This means things are getting more expensive for everyone.
(这意味着对每个人来说，东西都变得更贵了。)
[Aria] Food, gas, and other things cost more money now.
(食物、汽油和其他东西现在花费更多钱。)
[Andrew] The government is worried. They want to stop this from getting worse.
(政府很担心。他们想阻止这种情况恶化。)
[Aria] The stock market is also feeling the pain. The Dow is down.
(股市也感受到了痛苦。道琼斯指数下跌了。)
[Andrew] Investors are selling their stocks because they are afraid.
(投资者因为害怕而卖出他们的股票。)
[Aria] They do not know if the economy will be safe.
(他们不知道经济是否会安全。)
[Andrew] There is also news about SpaceX. People want to buy their stock.
(还有关于 SpaceX 的新闻。人们想买他们的股票。)
[Aria] But the company has not started selling stock yet.
(但该公司还没有开始出售股票。)
[Andrew] People are waiting for the IPO. That is when a company first sells stock.
(人们在等待首次公开募股。那是公司第一次出售股票的时候。)
[Aria] The demand is very high. It is four times more than expected.
(需求非常高。是预期的四倍。)
[Andrew] That shows how much people believe in the future of space travel.
(这显示了人们对太空旅行未来的信心。)
[Aria] Let us talk about energy. GM is doing something new.
(让我们谈谈能源。通用汽车正在做一些新的事情。)
[Andrew] They are making new batteries for energy storage.
(他们正在制造用于储能的新电池。)
[Aria] This will help keep power for when it is needed.
(这将有助于在需要时保持电力。)
[Andrew] They are also letting people sell power back to the grid.
(他们还允许人们将电力卖回电网。)
[Aria] That is a smart way to use electric cars.
(这是使用电动汽车的一种聪明方式。)
[Andrew] Now, let us look at China. There is news about their car market.
(现在，让我们看看中国。有关于他们汽车市场的新闻。)
[Aria] The demand for cars inside China is under pressure.
(中国国内对汽车的需求正面临压力。)
[Andrew] But they are selling many cars to other countries.
(但他们正在向其他国家销售许多汽车。)
[Aria] This helps keep their car companies strong.
(这有助于保持他们汽车公司的强大。)
[Aria] China is also spending a lot of money on data centers.
(中国也在数据中心上投入大量资金。)
[Aria] They want to be the best in artificial intelligence.
(他们想在人工智能方面做到最好。)
[Andrew] That is a very big plan. It will cost almost three hundred billion dollars.
(那是一个非常大的计划。它将花费近三千亿美元。)
[Aria] That is a lot of money for technology.
(这对技术来说是一大笔钱。)
[Andrew] Now, let us talk about the world and conflicts.
(现在，让我们谈谈世界和冲突。)
[Aria] There is tension between the United States and Iran.
(美国和伊朗之间存在紧张局势。)
[Andrew] Donald Trump said Iran will pay the price.
(唐纳德·特朗普说伊朗将付出代价。)
[Aria] This is because Iran targeted American assets.
(这是因为伊朗针对了美国的资产。)
[Andrew] The situation is very serious. People are watching it closely.
(局势非常严重。人们正在密切关注。)
[Aria] Also, there is trouble in Belfast.
(此外，贝尔法斯特也出现了麻烦。)
[Andrew] There were violent protests after a knife attack.
(在一次持刀袭击后发生了暴力抗议。)
[Aria] People are angry about immigration. It is a difficult time.
(人们对移民感到愤怒。这是一个困难的时期。)
[Andrew] We also have a strange story from Canada.
(我们还有一个来自加拿大的奇怪故事。)
[Aria] An Air Canada pilot flew for years with a fake license.
(一名加拿大航空公司的飞行员用假执照飞行了多年。)
[Andrew] That is very dangerous. How did no one know?
(那非常危险。怎么会没有人知道呢？)
[Aria] It is a mystery. The police are looking into it now.
(这是一个谜。警察现在正在调查。)
[Andrew] Finally, let us talk about China and North Korea.
(最后，让我们谈谈中国和朝鲜。)
[Aria] They are making their ties stronger again.
(他们正在再次加强他们的联系。)
[Andrew] This is important for the balance of power in the area.
(这对该地区的权力平衡很重要。)
[Aria] It is a complex world we live in.
(我们生活在一个复杂的世界里。)
[Andrew] Yes, it is. We have covered a lot today.
(是的，确实如此。我们今天谈了很多。)
[Aria] We talked about Apple, money, cars, and world news.
(我们谈到了苹果、金钱、汽车和世界新闻。)
[Andrew] We hope this helps you learn more English.
(我们希望这能帮助你学习更多的英语。)
[Aria] Thank you for listening to our podcast.
(感谢收听我们的播客。)
[Andrew] See you tomorrow for more news.
(明天见，会有更多新闻。)
[Aria] Have a good day and keep learning.
(祝你有美好的一天，继续学习。)
[Andrew] Goodbye for now.
(再见。)

item.title: 2026-06-10 Morning News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good morning everyone! Welcome to our morning news podcast. I am Aria.
(大家早上好！欢迎收听我们的早间新闻播客。我是 Aria。)

[Andrew] And I am Andrew. We have a very busy day of news for you.
(我是 Andrew。今天我们有很多重要新闻要告诉大家。)

[Aria] We will start with the world of technology. Apple has a new problem. The iPhone 17 has a limit of 8GB of memory. Because of this, it cannot use two new AI features in the new system.
(我们先从科技界开始。苹果公司遇到了一个新问题。iPhone 17 的内存限制为 8GB。因此，它无法使用新系统中的两项人工智能功能。)

[Andrew] That is a big deal, Aria. Apple is trying to be a leader in the AI race. But if the hardware is not strong enough, the software cannot work well. This shows that even a great company has limits.
(这很重要，Aria。苹果正试图成为人工智能竞赛的领导者。但如果硬件不够强大，软件就无法良好运行。这表明即使是一家伟大的公司也有局限性。)

[Aria] It is true. History shows that Apple likes to keep things simple. But AI needs a lot of power. The new AI models from Apple are very complex. They need a lot of memory to work.
(确实如此。历史表明苹果喜欢保持简单。但人工智能需要强大的能力。苹果的新人工智能模型非常复杂。它们需要大量内存才能工作。)

[Andrew] And we also see news about the Honor Magic V6. It is a folding phone. People call it a mechanical wonder. It is very different from the normal phones we see every day.
(我们还看到了关于荣耀 Magic V6 的新闻。这是一款折叠手机。人们称它为机械奇迹。它与我们每天看到的普通手机非常不同。)

[Aria] I like the idea of a folding phone. It gives you a big screen in a small body. But is it strong enough? That is the question many people ask.
(我喜欢折叠手机的想法。它让你在小巧的机身中拥有大屏幕。但它足够坚固吗？这是许多人提出的问题。)

[Andrew] The company says it will have seven years of support. That is a long time for a phone. It shows they believe in the quality of their work.
(该公司表示将提供七年的支持。对于手机来说，这很长。这表明他们对自己的产品质量充满信心。)

[Aria] Let us move to business. The news is not very good. US inflation is now at 4.2 percent. This is because of the energy shock in the Middle East.
(让我们转向商业新闻。消息不太好。美国通货膨胀率现在为 4.2%。这是因为中东的能源冲击。)

[Andrew] Inflation is a hard word for many families. It means the price of food and gas goes up. When prices go up, people have less money to spend on other things.
(对于许多家庭来说，通货膨胀是一个沉重的词。这意味着食品和汽油的价格上涨。当价格上涨时，人们花在其他事情上的钱就变少了。)

[Aria] And the stock market is feeling the pain. The Dow dropped 650 points. This happened because of the news about inflation and the tension with Iran.
(股市也感受到了痛苦。道琼斯指数下跌了 650 点。这是因为通货膨胀的消息以及与伊朗的紧张关系。)

[Andrew] Trump said that Iran will pay the price. This kind of talk makes the market nervous. Investors do not like uncertainty. They want to know that the world is safe.
(特朗普表示伊朗将付出代价。这种言论让市场感到紧张。投资者不喜欢不确定性。他们希望世界是安全的。)

[Aria] Speaking of money, many people want to buy stock in SpaceX. But it is not easy. The price is very high. It is a big risk for a normal person.
(说到钱，许多人想购买 SpaceX 的股票。但这并不容易。价格非常高。对于普通人来说，这是一个巨大的风险。)

[Andrew] SpaceX is doing great work with Starlink. It is a real business that makes money. But buying into a private company is very different from buying a normal stock.
(SpaceX 在星链项目上做得很好。这是一项真正赚钱的业务。但投资一家私人公司与购买普通股票非常不同。)

[Aria] Let us talk about AI again. Anthropic has a new model called Claude Fable 5. It is very powerful. But some people are worried about the security.
(让我们再谈谈人工智能。Anthropic 有一个名为 Claude Fable 5 的新模型。它非常强大。但有些人担心它的安全性。)

[Andrew] Security is the most important thing for AI. If the model is too smart, it might do things we do not want. We need to have guardrails.
(安全性是人工智能最重要的事。如果模型太聪明，它可能会做我们不想要的事情。我们需要设置护栏。)

[Aria] That is a good point. We want the benefits of AI, but we must be safe. It is a balance between progress and danger.
(说得好。我们想要人工智能带来的好处，但我们必须安全。这是进步与危险之间的平衡。)

[Andrew] Now, let us look at China. The car market is under pressure. People are not buying as many cars as before.
(现在，让我们看看中国。汽车市场正面临压力。人们购买的汽车不如以前多了。)

[Aria] But the export of new energy vehicles is strong. This helps the companies stay in business. It is a change in the way they sell cars.
(但新能源汽车的出口很强劲。这有助于公司维持业务。这是他们销售汽车方式的一种改变。)

[Aria] Also, China has a big plan for AI data centers. They want to use their own chips. This is a very big investment.
(此外，中国在人工智能数据中心方面有一个宏大的计划。他们想使用自己的芯片。这是一项非常大的投资。)

[Andrew] Using local chips is a smart move. It makes them less dependent on other countries. But it is hard to make high-quality chips.
(使用本地芯片是明智之举。这使他们减少了对他国的依赖。但制造高质量的芯片很难。)

[Aria] We have to talk about the world news. There are protests in Belfast. It started after a stabbing attack. It is a very sad situation.
(我们必须谈谈世界新闻。贝尔法斯特发生了抗议活动。这是在一次刺伤袭击后开始的。这是一个非常悲伤的情况。)

[Andrew] Violence is never the answer. We hope the people there can find peace soon. It is a hard time for the city.
(暴力永远不是答案。我们希望那里的人们能尽快找到和平。这对城市来说是一个艰难的时期。)

[Aria] And we see China and North Korea working on their relationship. This changes the balance of power in the region.
(我们看到中国和朝鲜正在改善他们的关系。这改变了该地区的权力平衡。)

[Andrew] Yes, it is a complex situation. Every country wants to be in a strong position. Diplomacy is the best way to handle these things.
(是的，这是一个复杂的情况。每个国家都想处于有利地位。外交是处理这些事情的最好方式。)

[Aria] Finally, let us look at the fighter jet problem in Europe. Germany and France are having a hard time working together.
(最后，让我们看看欧洲的战斗机问题。德国和法国在合作方面遇到了困难。)

[Andrew] It is hard to build a plane together. Each country has its own ideas. They want to protect their own industry.
(一起制造飞机很难。每个国家都有自己的想法。他们想保护自己的工业。)

[Aria] But they need to work together to be strong. A united Europe is better for everyone.
(但他们需要合作才能强大。一个团结的欧洲对每个人都更好。)

[Andrew] That is all the time we have for today. It was a lot of news.
(这就是我们今天的所有时间了。新闻很多。)

[Aria] Thank you for listening. We will be back tomorrow with more news. Have a great day!
(感谢收听。我们明天会带着更多新闻回来。祝大家度过愉快的一天！)

[Andrew] Goodbye everyone!
(大家再见！)

[Aria] We should talk more about the iPhone 17. Why is 8GB not enough? Because the new AI features need to keep a lot of data in the memory. If the memory is full, the phone becomes slow.
(我们应该多谈谈 iPhone 17。为什么 8GB 不够？因为新的人工智能功能需要在内存中保留大量数据。如果内存满了，手机就会变慢。)

[Andrew] That makes sense. It is like a person trying to remember too many things at once. If you have a small brain, you get tired.
(这很有道理。就像一个人试图同时记住太多事情。如果你大脑容量小，你就会感到疲倦。)

[Aria] Exactly. And Apple is trying to make the phone do more things on the device itself. This is called private cloud compute. It is safer, but it needs more power.
(没错。苹果正试图让手机在设备本身上做更多事情。这被称为私有云计算。它更安全，但需要更多的能量。)

[Andrew] I think the Honor Magic V6 is interesting because of the screen. Folding screens are the future. But they are hard to make.
(我认为荣耀 Magic V6 因为屏幕而很有趣。折叠屏是未来。但它们很难制造。)

[Aria] Yes, the mechanical parts must be perfect. If they break, the phone is useless. That is why the seven-year update is so important. It gives the user peace of mind.
(是的，机械部件必须完美。如果它们坏了，手机就没用了。这就是为什么七年更新如此重要。它让用户感到安心。)

[Andrew] Let us go back to the inflation news. 4.2 percent is a high number. The central bank will probably keep interest rates high. This makes it hard for people to buy houses.
(让我们回到通货膨胀的新闻。4.2% 是一个很高的数字。中央银行可能会保持高利率。这使得人们很难买房。)

[Aria] That is a very important point. High interest rates are a tool to stop inflation. But they hurt the common person. It is a difficult choice for the government.
(这是一个非常重要的点。高利率是阻止通货膨胀的工具。但它们伤害了普通人。这对政府来说是一个艰难的选择。)

[Andrew] And the Middle East energy shock. Oil is the life of the world economy. If the price of oil goes up, everything else goes up.
(还有中东的能源冲击。石油是世界经济的生命线。如果石油价格上涨，其他一切都会上涨。)

[Aria] It is a chain reaction. The cost of transport goes up. The cost of food goes up. The cost of electricity goes up.
(这是一种连锁反应。运输成本上涨。食品成本上涨。电力成本上涨。)

[Andrew] We see this in the stock market too. Companies that use a lot of energy are losing money. Their profit margins are getting smaller.
(我们在股市中也看到了这一点。消耗大量能源的公司正在亏损。他们的利润率正在变小。)

[Aria] What about SpaceX? Why is the IPO so shocking? Because people think it will be a great company in the future. Everyone wants a piece of it.
(SpaceX 怎么样？为什么首次公开募股如此令人震惊？因为人们认为它在未来会是一家伟大的公司。每个人都想分一杯羹。)

[Andrew] But the price is based on hope, not just current profit. That is why it is risky. You are buying the future, not the past.
(但价格是基于希望，而不仅仅是当前的利润。这就是为什么它有风险。你买的是未来，而不是过去。)

[Aria] Let us talk about Claude Fable 5 again. Anthropic is a company that cares about safety. They are different from other AI companies.
(让我们再谈谈 Claude Fable 5。Anthropic 是一家关心安全的公司。他们与其他人工智能公司不同。)

[Andrew] They want to make sure the AI does not harm people. This is a good goal. But it makes the model slower to release.
(他们想确保人工智能不会伤害人类。这是一个很好的目标。但它使模型的发布速度变慢了。)

[Aria] It is a trade-off. Do you want it fast, or do you want it safe? Most people want both.
(这是一个权衡。你想要它快，还是想要它安全？大多数人两者都想要。)

[Andrew] In China, the car market is changing. People want electric cars. But the competition is very high. Many companies are making cars.
(在中国，汽车市场正在发生变化。人们想要电动汽车。但竞争非常激烈。许多公司都在制造汽车。)

[Aria] That is why the domestic demand is under pressure. There are too many choices. And the economy is not growing as fast as before.
(这就是为什么国内需求面临压力。选择太多了。而且经济增长不如以前快了。)

[Andrew] But the exports are doing well. They are selling cars to other countries. This is a smart way to grow.
(但出口表现良好。他们正在向其他国家销售汽车。这是一种明智的增长方式。)

[Aria] And the AI data center plan. $295 billion is a lot of money. It shows how important AI is to the future of the country.
(还有人工智能数据中心计划。2950 亿美元是一笔巨款。这表明人工智能对国家的未来有多重要。)

[Andrew] They want to be independent. They do not want to rely on chips from other countries. This is a long-term plan.
(他们想独立。他们不想依赖其他国家的芯片。这是一个长期计划。)

[Aria] Let us look at the protests in Belfast again. It is a reminder that society is fragile. We need to listen to each other.
(让我们再看看贝尔法斯特的抗议活动。这提醒我们社会是脆弱的。我们需要倾听彼此。)

[Andrew] Yes, communication is key. When people feel they are not heard, they get angry. And anger leads to bad things.
(是的，沟通是关键。当人们觉得没有被倾听时，他们会生气。而愤怒会导致坏事。)

[Aria] And the North Korea and China relationship. It is a game of chess. Everyone is moving their pieces.
(还有朝鲜和中国的关系。这是一场国际象棋游戏。每个人都在移动他们的棋子。)

[Andrew] It is about influence. China wants to keep the region stable. North Korea wants to be a strong player.
(这关乎影响力。中国希望保持地区稳定。朝鲜希望成为一个强大的参与者。)

[Aria] Finally, the fighter jet. It is a symbol of European unity. If they cannot build a jet together, what does it mean for other things?
(最后，战斗机。它是欧洲团结的象征。如果他们不能一起制造喷气式飞机，这对其他事情意味着什么？)

[Andrew] It means that unity is hard. But it is necessary. Europe needs to be strong to protect itself.
(这意味着团结很难。但这是必要的。欧洲需要强大起来才能保护自己。)

[Aria] We have covered a lot today. Technology, money, and world events. It is all connected.
(我们今天涵盖了很多内容。科技、金钱和世界大事。它们都是相互关联的。)

[Andrew] Everything we do affects everything else. That is the world we live in.
(我们所做的一切都会影响其他一切。这就是我们生活的世界。)

[Aria] Thank you for staying with us. We hope you learned something new today.
(感谢你们陪伴我们。我们希望你们今天学到了新东西。)

[Andrew] See you tomorrow for more news.
(明天见，获取更多新闻。)

[Aria] Goodbye!
(再见！)

[Andrew] Goodbye!
(再见！)

item.title: 2026-06-11 Morning News Podcast
item.description:
[Aria] Good morning everyone. Welcome to our daily news show. I am Aria.
(大家早上好。欢迎收听我们的每日新闻节目。我是 Aria。)

[Andrew] And I am Andrew. We have a very full day of news for you.
(我是 Andrew。今天我们有非常丰富的新闻内容带给大家。)

[Aria] We will talk about Apple and their new machine learning work.
(我们将讨论苹果公司及其新的机器学习工作。)

[Andrew] Yes, and we have news about Valve and their gift cards.
(是的，我们还有关于 Valve 公司及其礼品卡的新闻。)

[Aria] We also have a story about space and clothes.
(我们还有一个关于太空和服装的故事。)

[Andrew] And we will look at the money market and some trouble in the world.
(我们还将关注金融市场以及世界上的一些麻烦。)

[Aria] Let us start with Apple. They have a new system for their machine learning.
(让我们从苹果公司开始。他们有一个新的机器学习系统。)

[Andrew] It is very interesting. The new system knows when to be quiet.
(这非常有趣。这个新系统知道什么时候该安静。)

[Aria] Many people use Siri every day. Sometimes Siri talks too much.
(很多人每天都在使用 Siri。有时 Siri 说话太多了。)

[Aria] Now, Apple says the new system is better at listening.
(现在，苹果公司表示新系统在倾听方面做得更好。)

[Andrew] This is part of a big change at Apple. They are in a race with other companies.
(这是苹果公司重大变革的一部分。他们正在与其他公司竞争。)

[Aria] The race is about who has the best artificial intelligence.
(这场竞争是关于谁拥有最好的人工智能。)

[Andrew] Apple is a dark horse. That means they might win even if people do not expect it.
(苹果是一匹黑马。这意味着即使人们没有预料到，他们也可能获胜。)

[Aria] They are also working with NVIDIA. This will help their private cloud.
(他们也在与英伟达合作。这将有助于他们的私有云。)

[Andrew] It is a smart move. Private cloud means the data stays safe.
(这是一个明智的举动。私有云意味着数据保持安全。)

[Aria] People care about their data. They do not want companies to see it.
(人们关心他们的数据。他们不希望公司看到这些数据。)

[Andrew] Apple knows this. They are building a system that is very private.
(苹果知道这一点。他们正在建立一个非常私密的系统。)

[Aria] Let us move to the next story. Valve is stopping their gift card program.
(让我们进入下一个故事。Valve 正在停止他们的礼品卡计划。)

[Andrew] This is because of bad people. They use the cards to take money from others.
(这是因为坏人。他们利用这些卡片从别人那里骗钱。)

[Aria] It is a shame. Many people liked to give these cards as gifts.
(真可惜。很多人喜欢把这些卡片作为礼物送人。)

[Andrew] But the scammers are too smart. Valve had to make a hard decision.
(但骗子太聪明了。Valve 不得不做出一个艰难的决定。)

[Aria] They will stop the physical cards by the end of the year.
(他们将在年底前停止实体卡。)

[Andrew] It is a good lesson for all of us. We must be careful with our money.
(这对我们所有人来说都是一个很好的教训。我们必须小心对待我们的钱。)

[Aria] Now, let us talk about the moon. NASA is working with Prada.
(现在，让我们谈谈月球。美国国家航空航天局正在与普拉达合作。)

[Andrew] Prada is a fashion company. Why are they making space clothes?
(普拉达是一家时尚公司。他们为什么要制作太空服？)

[Aria] They are making the suits for the Artemis mission.
(他们正在为阿尔忒弥斯任务制作宇航服。)

[Andrew] That is very cool. The astronauts will look very good on the moon.
(这太酷了。宇航员在月球上看起来会非常棒。)

[Aria] It is not just about looks. The suit must keep them cool and safe.
(这不仅仅是为了好看。宇航服必须让他们保持凉爽和安全。)

[Andrew] Space is a very hard place to be. The temperature changes a lot.
(太空是一个非常艰难的地方。温度变化很大。)

[Aria] Prada has the knowledge to make good material.
(普拉达有制造优质材料的知识。)

[Andrew] It shows that space is for everyone, even fashion designers.
(这表明太空属于每个人，甚至是时装设计师。)

[Aria] Let us look at the business news. Trump is talking about inflation.
(让我们看看商业新闻。特朗普正在谈论通货膨胀。)

[Andrew] He said he loves the inflation numbers. That is a strange thing to say.
(他说他喜欢通货膨胀数据。这真是一个奇怪的说法。)

[Aria] Many people are angry because prices are very high.
(很多人很生气，因为价格非常高。)

[Andrew] Yes, the cost of food and other things is going up.
(是的，食品和其他东西的成本正在上涨。)

[Aria] Trump is also angry at Iran. He said they will pay a price.
(特朗普也对伊朗感到愤怒。他说他们将付出代价。)

[Andrew] This makes the market very nervous. When there is war, stocks go down.
(这让市场非常紧张。当有战争时，股票就会下跌。)

[Aria] We saw the stock market drop today. The Dow fell a lot.
(我们今天看到股市下跌。道琼斯指数跌了很多。)

[Andrew] People are worried about the future. They are selling their stocks.
(人们担心未来。他们正在抛售股票。)

[Aria] And then there is SpaceX. People want to buy their stock.
(还有 SpaceX。人们想买他们的股票。)

[Andrew] It is a big company. Elon Musk is the owner.
(这是一家大公司。埃隆·马斯克是所有者。)

[Aria] Some people think it is a great investment. Others are not so sure.
(有些人认为这是一个很好的投资。其他人则不太确定。)

[Andrew] A man named Jim Chanos said it is just hopes and dreams.
(一个叫吉姆·查诺斯的人说这只是希望和梦想。)

[Aria] That is a strong opinion. Investing is always a risk.
(那是一个强烈的观点。投资总是有风险的。)

[Andrew] We must always do our own research before we buy anything.
(在购买任何东西之前，我们必须始终进行自己的研究。)

[Aria] Let us talk about the world. There is a big church in Barcelona.
(让我们谈谈世界。巴塞罗那有一座大教堂。)

[Andrew] The Sagrada Familia. It is a very famous building.
(圣家堂。这是一个非常著名的建筑。)

[Aria] The Pope went there to give it a blessing.
(教皇去了那里进行祝福。)

[Andrew] It took a very long time to build. It is a work of art.
(它花了很长时间才建成。这是一件艺术品。)

[Aria] Some people love it, but some people think it is strange.
(有些人喜欢它，但有些人认为它很奇怪。)

[Andrew] That is the beauty of art. Everyone sees it in a different way.
(这就是艺术的美。每个人以不同的方式看待它。)

[Aria] Now, let us look at Canada. They have a new plan for children.
(现在，让我们看看加拿大。他们有一个针对儿童的新计划。)

[Andrew] They want to stop children from using social media.
(他们想阻止儿童使用社交媒体。)

[Aria] They are making a law for people under 16.
(他们正在为 16 岁以下的人制定法律。)

[Andrew] This is a big step. Many countries are thinking about this.
(这是一个大步骤。许多国家都在考虑这一点。)

[Aria] Social media can be bad for young minds.
(社交媒体对年轻人的思想可能有害。)

[Andrew] But it is hard to control. How will they stop it?
(但它很难控制。他们将如何阻止它？)

[Aria] The law will force companies to change their systems.
(法律将迫使公司改变他们的系统。)

[Andrew] It will be interesting to see if it works.
(看看它是否有效将会很有趣。)

[Aria] Finally, there is trouble in Northern Ireland.
(最后，北爱尔兰出现了麻烦。)

[Andrew] There was a fight in the street. The police had to use water.
(街上发生了打斗。警察不得不使用水炮。)

[Aria] It is a sad situation. People are very angry about many things.
(这是一个悲伤的情况。人们对很多事情感到非常愤怒。)

[Andrew] We hope that things will get better soon. Peace is important.
(我们希望情况能很快好转。和平很重要。)

[Aria] That is all the news for today. Thank you for listening.
(这就是今天的所有新闻。谢谢大家的收听。)

[Andrew] We will be back tomorrow with more news. Have a great day.
(我们明天会带着更多新闻回来。祝大家有美好的一天。)

[Aria] Remember to keep learning and keep listening.
(记得继续学习，继续倾听。)

[Andrew] Goodbye for now.
(再见。)

[Aria] Goodbye.
(再见。)

[Andrew] Let us talk more about the Apple news. It is very important for the future.
(让我们多谈谈苹果的新闻。这对未来非常重要。)

[Aria] Yes, artificial intelligence is changing everything.
(是的，人工智能正在改变一切。)

[Andrew] Even the way we talk to our phones.
(甚至是我们与手机交谈的方式。)

[Aria] Siri is becoming more like a person.
(Siri 变得越来越像一个人。)

[Andrew] But a person who knows when to be quiet.
(但一个知道什么时候该安静的人。)

[Aria] That is a good quality in a person too.
(这也是一个人应有的好品质。)

[Andrew] I agree. Sometimes we talk too much.
(我同意。有时我们说得太多了。)

[Aria] Let us go back to the SpaceX story. Why are people so excited?
(让我们回到 SpaceX 的故事。为什么人们如此兴奋？)

[Andrew] Because space is the next big thing.
(因为太空是下一个大事件。)

[Aria] People want to be part of the future.
(人们想成为未来的一部分。)

[Andrew] And they want to make money from it.
(而且他们想从中赚钱。)

[Aria] But it is a long way to the moon.
(但去月球的路很长。)

[Andrew] And it is a long way to make a profit.
(而且盈利的路也很长。)

[Aria] That is why some people are worried.
(这就是为什么有些人很担心。)

[Andrew] But that is business. It is always a risk.
(但这就是生意。它总是有风险的。)

[Aria] What about the Prada space suit? Do you think it is expensive?
(普拉达的宇航服怎么样？你觉得它贵吗？)

[Andrew] Oh, very expensive. Prada is a luxury brand.
(哦，非常贵。普拉达是一个奢侈品牌。)

[Aria] But NASA needs the best.
(但美国国家航空航天局需要最好的。)

[Andrew] If it keeps the astronauts safe, it is worth the price.
(如果它能保证宇航员的安全，那么它就值这个价。)

[Aria] Safety is the most important thing in space.
(安全是太空中最重要的事情。)

[Andrew] I agree. We cannot have accidents in space.
(我同意。我们不能在太空中发生事故。)

[Aria] Let us talk about the inflation again. It is a big problem.
(让我们再谈谈通货膨胀。这是一个大问题。)

[Andrew] Yes, it makes life hard for many families.
(是的，它让许多家庭的生活变得艰难。)

[Aria] When food is expensive, people have less money for other things.
(当食物昂贵时，人们用于其他事情的钱就少了。)

[Andrew] And when money is tight, people get angry.
(当钱紧张时，人们就会生气。)

[Aria] That is why the government must act.
(这就是为什么政府必须采取行动。)

[Andrew] But it is not easy to fix.
(但它并不容易解决。)

[Aria] No, it takes time and good decisions.
(不，这需要时间和好的决定。)

[Andrew] Let us talk about the Sagrada Familia. Have you ever been there?
(让我们谈谈圣家堂。你去过那里吗？)

[Aria] No, but I have seen pictures. It is beautiful.
(没有，但我看过照片。它很美。)

[Andrew] It looks like a building from a dream.
(它看起来像梦中的建筑。)

[Aria] The shapes are very different from normal buildings.
(这些形状与普通建筑非常不同。)

[Andrew] That is why it is so famous.
(这就是它如此著名的原因。)

[Aria] It is good that the Pope went to see it.
(教皇去看了它很好。)

[Andrew] It brings attention to the art and the history.
(它引起了人们对艺术和历史的关注。)

[Aria] And it brings people together.
(它把人们聚集在一起。)

[Andrew] That is what we need in the world today.
(这就是我们今天在世界上所需要的。)

[Aria] We need more peace and more art.
(我们需要更多的和平和更多的艺术。)

[Andrew] And less fighting in the streets.
(以及更少的街头打斗。)

[Aria] The news in Northern Ireland is very sad.
(北爱尔兰的新闻非常令人难过。)

[Andrew] We hope the people there can find a way to talk.
(我们希望那里的人们能找到一种交谈的方式。)

[Aria] Talking is better than fighting.
(交谈比打架好。)

[Andrew] Always.
(总是如此。)

[Aria] We have talked about many things today.
(我们今天谈了很多事情。)

[Andrew] Technology, space, business, and world events.
(技术、太空、商业和世界事件。)

[Aria] It is important to know what is happening.
(了解正在发生的事情很重要。)

[Andrew] It helps us understand the world better.
(它帮助我们更好地了解世界。)

[Aria] And it helps us learn English too.
(它也帮助我们学习英语。)

[Andrew] Yes, the more we listen, the better we get.
(是的，我们听得越多，我们就越好。)

[Aria] Our listeners are doing a great job.
(我们的听众做得很好。)

[Andrew] They are learning new words every day.
(他们每天都在学习新单词。)

[Aria] And they are learning about the world.
(他们也在了解世界。)

[Andrew] That is the goal of this show.
(这就是本节目的目标。)

[Aria] To learn and to grow together.
(一起学习，一起成长。)

[Andrew] I am happy to be here with you, Aria.
(我很高兴能和你在这里，Aria。)

[Aria] I am happy too, Andrew.
(我也很高兴，Andrew。)

[Andrew] We have a good team.
(我们有一个好的团队。)

[Aria] We do. And we have great listeners.
(是的。而且我们有很棒的听众。)

[Andrew] Let us finish for today.
(让我们今天结束吧。)

[Aria] Yes, let us rest and get ready for tomorrow.
(是的，让我们休息一下，为明天做好准备。)

[Andrew] See you all tomorrow.
(明天见。)

[Aria] Goodbye everyone.
(再见大家。)

[Andrew] Keep learning.
(继续学习。)

[Aria] Keep growing.
(继续成长。)

[Andrew] And keep listening to the news.
(并继续收听新闻。)

[Aria] It is the best way to start the day.
(这是开始新的一天的最好方式。)

[Andrew] Have a wonderful day.
(祝你有美好的一天。)

[Aria] See you soon.
(很快再见。)

[Andrew] Goodbye.
(再见。)

[Aria] Goodbye.
(再见。)
